text: The human compatibility port comments out from-repo/to-repo Mercurial URLs while retaining branch identifiers in the Thunderbird merge routes. It is a scoped input change for the landoscript transition, not a general YAML style or permanent requirement to comment out configuration. At the fixed comparison revision the merge-automation section is absent entirely; the later migration rationale and upstream consumer remain source-ingestion gaps. This supplemental commit fell between manifest entries2601and2602 and receives no additional manifest audit count. No merge task, uplift or build ran.
title: The May2025 landoscript port stopped passing Mercurial repository URLs
